name: resistance band lateral hit
description: A standing band press that sweeps across the body from the side. It builds chest power and trains the trunk to resist rotation.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
